footer.tagline: Shared memory for those who matter.

home.title: Honor the memory of those who matter
home.lead: Testimona is the space where memories of the departed live on. Share testimonials, photos and videos, and support grieving families.
home.featureTestimonialsDesc: Gather memories from loved ones, in French or English.
home.featureBiographyDesc: Compose the biography chapter by chapter, together with relatives.
home.featureDonationsDesc: Support grieving families with a secure donation via Stripe.

about.title: About Testimona
about.lead: A platform dedicated to commemorating the departed — preserving memories and supporting families.
about.visionBody: Celebrate the lives of the departed by creating a space to share joyful memories that endure for relatives and future generations.
about.missionBody: Become the reference social platform for commemorating lives, where loved ones publish testimonials and anecdotes, shared and preserved for future generations.
about.howStep1Body: Provide the person's name, add your memory, photos or videos.
about.howStep2Body: If no page exists yet, Testimona creates one automatically from the information you provided.
about.howStep3Body: Close relatives can expand the biography, moderate content, and organize a fundraiser.
